lines: Revenue was $209.8 million, essentially flat year over year; excluding an $8.1 million headwind, revenue grew about 4%.
GAAP net loss was $7.9 million, or $0.08 per share; adjusted EPS was $0.04 and adjusted EBITDA was $14.3 million.
The company reiterated its full-year 2026 financial guidance.
Revenue was $200.4 million, up 2% year over year.
Cancer Care Continuum test volume grew 13% and Mental Health 7%, while Prenatal Health volume declined 12%.
Gross margin was 68.7%; GAAP net loss was $34.1 million, adjusted loss was $0.09 per share and adjusted EBITDA was negative $4.5 million.
The company reiterated its full-year 2026 guidance.
Revenue was $190.7 million, down 11% year over year; total test volume was 379,000, down 1%.
Cancer Care Continuum volume grew 6%, Prenatal Health declined 9%, and Mental Health grew 4%.
Gross margin was 66.6%; GAAP net loss was $43.2 million, or $0.46 per share.
2026 revenue guidance was revised to $770-$790 million with adjusted gross margin of 66%-67%; prior adjusted EBITDA guidance was suspended.
